recipe.visualDefinition: A satirical illustration featuring two caricatured figures against a vibrant, multi-colored cross-hatched background, framed by a thick, solid red border with bold yellow sans-serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction through gestural posing and contrasting attire
Textural contrast between flat red border and textured pencil illustration
Color harmony between the yellow text and the warm tones in the central art
Dynamic energy created by radiating diagonal hatch marks
coreInvariants: Caricatured facial features with exaggerated expressions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body figures centered within a white rectangular inset, occupying 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figure on the left in a bright red outfit, acting as a focal point against the cooler tones of the second figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top title, down to the expressive faces of the caricatures, following the diagonal background lines, and resting on the bottom credit.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and bold framing.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-color spectrum (Green, Blue, Orange, Pink in background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout, with heavy black outlines providing structural value.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is simplified and geometric

composition.position: Top and bottom margins of the red frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both title and artist name for cohesive branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s geometric aesthetic and wide proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric purity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a satirical caricature illustration of two figures in a 1970s editorial style. Use colored pencil and marker textures with heavy cross-hatching in a radiating pattern of green, blue, and orange. Place this inside a white rectangle, which is itself centered inside a thick, solid red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, yellow geometric sans-serif text in all caps. Place one line centered in the top red margin and one line centered in the bottom red margin.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thick and solid?
Does the background feature visible pencil/marker texture?
Is the typography bright yellow and geometric?
Are the figures caricatured with expressive faces?

mustRedesign: Specific facial likenesses to avoid protected identities
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cross-hatching looks like physical media.
Verify the yellow text is legible against the red background.
Check that the caricatures have a consistent illustrative style.
Confirm the white inner border separates the art from the red frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured, hand-drawn caricature inset with a thick solid-color frame and bold geometric display type for a retro satirical look.
